payload.indexed_content_rule: released message text only; no persona/session/turn id, no role, no date, no label
payload.ingestion_unit: one well-formed released dialogue message = one write
payload.isolation: fresh encrypted SQLite vault and key per persona
payload.lifecycle_calls: none; no supersede, update, delete or maintenance is issued
payload.post_filtering: none; native order, native score and native limit are preserved
payload.profile: raw_product, Gen29 identity: operator CLI write + native hybrid recall
